code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r]) and sum(grid[r][0] == grid[i][0] for i in [r]) and grid[r][0] != grid[0][0]), None)
    # Find separator rows/columns as uniform lines distinct from background.
    sr = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != grid[0][0]]
    sc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != grid[0][0]]
    rb=[0]+[x+1 for x in sr]; re=sr+[h]
    cb=[0]+[x+1 for x in sc]; ce=sc+[w]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Collect all non-background, non-separator marks, normalized to the repeated tile.
    bg=grid[0][0]
    marks={}
    for r in range(h):
      if r in sr: continue
      for c in range(w):
        if c in sc: continue
        if grid[r][c] != bg:
          ri=max(i for i,b in enumerate(rb) if b<=r); ci=max(i for i,b in enumerate(cb) if b<=c)
          marks[(r-rb[ri],c-cb[ci])]=grid[r][c]

    return out
